fact_check_log.claim: Headline rings: Diana's sapphire, later Catherine's (6)
Headline rings: Taylor Swift's old mine cut from 2025 (23)
Marie Claire, like most outlets, describes the ring as an emerald-cut diamond on a thin band.
Platinum beads inside the band, as in Diana's ring for Catherine, can adjust a fit without cutting it.
Fingers swell in heat and on long-haul flights (general advice tied to fact_26, as in round 1)
A low or bezel setting, like Taylor Swift's, wraps the stone's edge and copes better than tall claws.
Pearls, like the Akoya in Emma Stone's ring, are softer than diamonds.
Eternity band stones run the full circle, difficult to resize.
Wedded Wonderland plans destination weddings through Wedded Concierge.
One Wedded Advisor plans venue, travel, vendors and payments as your one point of contact; fee agreed in writing before any work begins.
Mary was born in Hobart, Tasmania.
